guard: the mesh handler's liveness pair is real: `down` is the death of ONE incarnation read off presence (name AND lifecycle uid), the reason distinguishes a lapsed name from a superseded one, the timeout is one absolute deadline that arms, expires, is attached to on re-entry, and is claimed on every ending, and `monitor` validates the registration it journals
why: Lane F durable-actions step 5 (2026-09-02): `monitor` + `wait(down)` leave the not-yet-durable
seam and perform over presence liveness. Each half of the contract has a mutant: the
incarnation pin in the liveness match (MM1), the death check itself (MM2), the two reasons
(MM3), the expiry observation (MM4), the timer claimed on a down (MM5), the arm that makes the
deadline exist at all (MM6), monitor's validation of the handle it registers (MM7), and the
routing that sends a down descriptor to this machinery instead of the channel path (MM8).
All eight mutate mesh-handler.ts, which the suite imports through a relative `../src` path —
no build sits between the mutation and the run.

mutations.name: the liveness match drops the incarnation: any row under the name reads as this agent
mutations.expectRed: a live successor under the name reads as superseded: this incarnation is dead
mutations.cell: a live successor under the name reads as superseded: this incarnation is dead
mutations.note: The handle pins <name>#<lifecycleUid>; with the uid dropped, a successor keeps the DEAD incarnation looking alive forever. Measured 2026-09-02: two reds — the superseded block's wait never resolves (its bounded deadline fails) and its reason cell reads undefined; 22 passed, 2 failed.

mutations.expectRed: an already-dead incarnation resolves without waiting for anything
mutations.cell: an already-dead incarnation resolves without waiting for anything
mutations.note: The primitive gone: every down-wait parks forever and only timeouts end anything. Measured 2026-09-02: twelve reds across the rescue-idiom, immediate-down and superseded blocks (each bounded wait fails its deadline and its value cells read undefined); 14 passed, 12 failed, the suite reaching its own exit.

mutations.note: The two reasons are the value's whole vocabulary; collapsed, a program cannot tell a vanished seat from a replaced one. Measured 2026-09-02: exactly one red, the superseded cell reading "lapsed" in the transcript; 22 passed.
